name: SubFlowOutput
caption: Return SubFlow Output

configuration.description: The values returned to the calling Run SubFlow step: array of {"name": string, "type": "Value"|"Reference", "tableNo": integer, "value": string}. name = output name seen by the caller (truncated to 30 chars there), keep it non-empty and unique; type "Value" or "Reference" (exact case, anything else counts as Value); tableNo is only used for Reference rows (the editor derives it from the selected reference and writes 0 for Value rows); value = SmartText for Value rows, a wrapped reference selector {{name}} for Reference rows. An empty array returns no outputs.

outputs.name: <outputs[].name>
outputs.when: one entry per outputs[] row with a name; 'reference' with that row's tableNo when type = "Reference". Informational only – the step ends the SubFlow; the values surface on the caller's Run SubFlow step.

rules.check: configuration.outputs, if present, is an array of objects; anything else is ignored and the SubFlow returns nothing.
outputs[].name values must be unique (case-sensitive); a duplicate fails the step when the return object is built.
rules.message: (platform JSON error about a duplicate key)

rules.check: outputs[].type is 'Value' or 'Reference' (exact case). Anything else is treated as Value.
The step is terminating: it must be the last step of its path (no following sibling step, no edges).
rules.message: Step "%1" is a terminating step but has a successor – terminating steps must end the path.

rules.check: Only offered in the step picker of flows whose trigger is 'When invoked as a SubFlow' (trigger 5564404). Not checked anywhere else.
rules.message: (no message – the step is hidden in other flows)

notes: Contract with the caller: the calling Run SubFlow step's outputs[] are generated from THIS step's configuration.outputs (name/type/tableNo) of the SubFlow version it pins. If a SubFlow contains several Return SubFlow Output steps (e.g. in different branches), only the first one found (document order, depth-first into edges) defines the caller's declared outputs – keep all of them identical.

Runtime: SmartFields in each value are resolved, the step builds a JSON object {name: value} (all values as strings), stops the SubFlow immediately and hands the object to the caller, which adds one value output per key. A duplicate name fails the step.
A SubFlow that ends without reaching this step returns no outputs (not an error).

Reference-typed returns: a selector that points at a record (e.g. {{FindCustomer_Rec}}) is not replaced with text, so the caller receives the selector text itself as a plain value. Return scalar values (No., SystemId) and find the record again in the caller.
